title: Logical Quiz: Can You Beat These 3?
hook: Only 1% of people can solve these 3 logic puzzles.
script:
Only 1% of people can solve these three logic puzzles. Think you're in the elite? Let's find out! You have just five seconds per question. Ready?

Question one: I am an odd number. Take away one letter and I become even. What number am I? Time's up! The answer is SEVEN. Remove the 'S' and you get 'EVEN'.

Question two: What has to be broken before you can use it? Five seconds, go! Got it? The answer is AN EGG. You can't make an omelet without breaking a few!

Question three: What is full of holes but still holds water? Your final five seconds start now! Think hard! And the solution is… A SPONGE. Simple, right?

How many did you get correct? Did you prove you're part of that top 1% who can solve these three logic puzzles?
